title: Resistance vs. impedance
idea: Resistance opposes every kind of current. Impedance is the opposition to AC current flow. Both are measured in ohms.

rows: All current: DC, AC and RF

cards.t: The opposition to AC current flow
cards.why: That is the definition of impedance.

cards.t: Opposes DC, AC and RF current

cards.why: Resistance and impedance are both in ohms.

cards.t: What a resistor gives a DC circuit
cards.why: A resistor opposes current flow in a DC circuit.

traps.why: Impedance is not the inverse of anything. It is opposition to AC, in ohms like resistance.

traps.wrong: The power handling capability of a component
traps.why: That is a power rating. Impedance is opposition to AC current flow.
True, but resistance opposes AC and RF too, so all these choices are correct.
The part made to oppose current in a DC circuit is the resistor.
